question: The player's last use of the Magic Treasure (法宝) Fire Shield (避火罩) was mainly to deal with which boss, and what is the Magic Treasure (法宝) replacement sequence afterward?
reference_answer: Feng-Tail General (凤翅将军). Afterward, it's all Banana Leaf Fan (芭蕉扇).

decisive_steps.what_happened: clip_qa(80280,80310) is the only visual check any rollout ran inside the true clue window; it correctly reports the menu order 冠(风翅紫金冠, worn) -> 芭蕉扇(已装备) -> 绣花针(selected, not equipped), matching the reference's 'afterward it's all 芭蕉扇' half.

Instead of running clip_qa on the actual boss fight inside the clue window (80176-80235s), the agent ran clip_qa(7260,7500) on the early Black Bear Guai fight it had already found via text search, getting visual confirmation of the wrong boss because it visually verified the wrong time window, not because the visual model was wrong.

rollouts.failure_point: Correctly solved the 'replacement sequence' half of the question (芭蕉扇 only, from 80280-80310s) but never pointed clip_qa at the 80176-80235s boss fight itself, so the boss identification stayed anchored on the wrong (early) event; overall answer combines a right half and a wrong half, still scored 0 by the judge for the wrong boss name.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Verified with sql/topic_facts that the 80160-80280s window is captioned as an unnamed 'fire giant (火之巨人)' boss fight immediately followed by a 凤翅紫金冠 crown reward and a 80280-80310s equip screen; frames/clip_qa in this window would have been the correct place to identify the true boss but none of the 5 rollouts tried it.

db_evidence.notes: The temporal window itself (80160-80310s and 83700-84269s) is fully present in episodes/topic_facts/semantic_triples, and correctly shows a boss fight immediately followed by a 凤翅紫金冠 crown reward, then an equip-menu confirming 芭蕉扇 equipped (80280-80310s) and a second unnamed fire-ring boss fight ending in '已击败' at 84270s. However the boss in the first fight is captioned only as 'fire giant (火之巨人)' with an incongruous Dark Souls III mislabel by the auto-captioner, and the boss in the second fight (83790-84269s) is captioned only as an unnamed 'boss on a rocky lava-veined plateau'/'armored warrior with tusked headdress' -- the actual proper name 'Feng-Tail General (凤翅将军)' never appears anywhere in episodes, topic_facts, semantic_triples, event_steps, entities, or visual_clips (verified by ILIKE search for '将军' and '凤翅将军' across all tables: zero rows). Separately, the item name 避火罩/辟火罩 itself appears exactly once in the whole DB, at its 6150s acquisition event; it is never mentioned again by name at any later 'use' event, so no amount of keyword/semantic text search over the item name alone can find the true last-use boss fight -- only a targeted visual (clip_qa) sweep of candidate late-game boss fights near the reference window could establish it.

root_causes: Acquisition/first-use conflation: 4 of 5 rollouts treated the single 6150s item-popup (get 辟火罩) plus the immediately-following 7260-7500s Black Bear Guai fight as the 'last use', because that is the only place the item name is textually present anywhere in the memory DB; none searched later in the timeline for a second, unnamed use of the same treasure.

Captioning/DB gap at the true clue window: the actual boss name 'Feng-Tail General (凤翅将军)' is never captured by the auto-captioner in any table -- the 80160s fight is mislabeled 'fire giant (火之巨人)' with a spurious Dark Souls III game-identification error, and the 83790-84269s fight is captioned only generically ('boss on rocky lava-veined plateau'), so pure text/semantic search over item or boss names cannot surface the reference boss.

Visual sub-agent misdirection, not misreading: the one rollout (04) that did use clip_qa pointed it at the wrong (early, textually-anchored) time window rather than the clue window it had already partially explored via SQL/topic_facts (78000-80310s), so the visual agent correctly answered a question about the wrong interval.

No rollout ran a systematic late-game sweep for fire-related boss encounters near the reference's implied end-game timing, despite having read the 'locating-time-intervals' skill; all treated the single textual hit as sufficient evidence and stopped searching once any first plausible-sounding fire boss was found.
what_worked: Rollout 4's clip_qa(80280,80310) correctly recovered the true 'replacement sequence' half of the answer (芭蕉扇 only, consistent with the reference's 'Afterward, it's all Banana Leaf Fan'), showing that visual verification of the actual clue window does work when applied to it.

Rollout 3 alone searched further along the timeline (finding a 67470s 赤焰麒麟 fight) rather than stopping at the very first fire-themed boss, showing partial awareness that 'last use' requires checking beyond the first hit, though it still stopped ~13-17k seconds short of the true window.
transferable_lessons: For 'last use of X' temporal questions, do not accept the only textual mention of an item as also being its last use; explicitly search near the end of the relevant story arc / near the end of the timeline for later, unnamed uses of the same item, since DB captions of gameplay events frequently omit re-stating an item's name each time it recurs.

When text/semantic search over an item or entity name returns exactly one hit, treat that as evidence the captioner under-labeled later occurrences (not as evidence there were no later occurrences), and switch to clip_qa sweeps of candidate later time windows (e.g., other boss fights with matching visual/thematic cues such as fire, lava, rings of flame) rather than accepting the single hit.

When clip_qa is used to verify a boss identity, point it at the specific interval already flagged as the answer's evidence window (e.g., from topic_facts/episodes proximate to a 'reward overlay' or 'defeated' event near the expected late-game time), not at an earlier interval merely because that is where the keyword search happened to land.

Game/boss names are frequently missing or garbled in the auto-generated captions (e.g., mislabeling a Black Myth: Wukong boss as a 'Dark Souls III fire giant'); when a caption's stated game/franchise looks inconsistent with the rest of the episode, treat the boss-name portion of that caption as unreliable and prefer clip_qa/frame inspection plus external knowledge of the actual game to identify it.
open_questions: Whether 'Feng-Tail General (凤翅将军)' is the game's real boss name for the fight at 80160-80235s (the one immediately preceding the 凤翅紫金冠 crown reward) or for the second, later fire-ring boss at 83790-84269s -- the memory DB gives no way to distinguish since neither caption names the boss; this would need direct frame inspection plus outside knowledge of Black Myth: Wukong boss names to resolve with certainty.

Whether an earlier, unindexed use of 避火罩 (before 80176s but after 7500s) exists that none of the 5 rollouts or this analysis surfaced, given the item name is otherwise absent from the DB after its 6150s acquisition.
